title: The Ultimate Backrooms
description: A Ultimate Backrooms Modpack with many Mods
body:
_# **The Ultimate Backrooms**_

A terrifying mix of Backrooms exploration and Horror survival, designed to turn Minecraft into a dark, unsettling, and unpredictable experience.  
This modpack combines multiple horror‑focused mods, atmospheric effects, and Backrooms‑inspired environments to create a unique and immersive nightmare.  


<details>
<summary>🕳️ Features</summary>

- Backrooms‑style levels with endless hallways, maze‑like structures, and eerie ambience
- Custom horror creatures that stalk, chase, or surprise the player
- Dark and immersive atmosphere with enhanced sounds, lighting, and visual effects
- Survival‑horror gameplay focused on tension, resource scarcity, and exploration
- Optional multiplayer support (adjust if needed)
- Designed for maximum immersion and fear

</details>


<details>
<summary>🎮 Who is this modpack for?</summary>
For players who enjoy psychological horror, creepy environments, and intense survival challenges.
Perfect for content creators, streamers, or anyone who wants a truly frightening Minecraft experience.
</details>




<details>
<summary>⚠️ Beta Notice</summary>

**This modpack is currently in Beta.
Bugs, missing features, or balancing issues may occur. Feedback is appreciated.**

</details>


<details>
<summary>🛠️ Upcoming Features</summary>
- 
- Standard horror world with new structures
- More custom horror mods
- Additional Backrooms‑inspired levels
- Improved sound design and atmosphere
- Performance and stability updates

</details>


<details>
<summary>ℹ️ Technical Information</summary>

- Modloader: Fabric
- Minecraft Version: ONLY 1.20.1
- Environment: Client & Server (Server-Side is experimental)

</details>
